confirmed_root_cause.summary: the J9 runner configured the environment with recording DISABLED and then required the recorded output. The contradiction is entirely internal to the J9 runner; the environment behaved exactly as configured.
confirmed_root_cause.deterministic: yes. It would fail identically on every cell and every run; it is not flaky and not environment-dependent.

chain.fact: the hardened builder makes recording conditional on its output_dir argument: record_outputs = bool(output_dir is not None); save_outputs_on_close = bool(output_dir is not None); and only inside `if output_dir is not None:` does it set output_dir = <root>/sim_outputs and output_prefix = 'j1_teacher_episode'.

base_env_config forwards that argument, and BOTH call sites - the preflight at 499 and run_matrix at 974 - pass output_dir=None. The base therefore carried record_outputs False, save_outputs_on_close False, and no output_dir or output_prefix key at all.
cell_env_config added back only env['output_dir'], leaving both flags False. The subset guard at 383 permits adding nothing but output_dir, so output_prefix could not be restored either.
close() calls self.runner.save_results() ONLY IF record_outputs AND save_outputs_on_close AND runner is not None. Both conjuncts were False, so save_results() was never called.
with record_outputs False the env calls _disable_output_files(cfg), which clears every save_* flag on the simulator config.
the stepper receives record=self.env_cfg.record_outputs (False), and reset_outputs() is skipped, so no sample was ever buffered.
the runner then required a non-empty per-cell sim_outputs directory that nothing had been asked to write, and raised.

confirmed_root_cause.counter_evidence_that_the_pattern_works: j3_runs/j3_base_v26c_2026-08-26_r1/sim_outputs contains 19 files, because J3 called the same builder with a real output_dir. J1, J3, J5 and J6 all ran with record_outputs True; J9 was the anomaly.
confirmed_root_cause.responsibility: a defect in the J9 runner authored for this stage, not in the environment, the builder, the actor or any production source.
